name: Mushroom-Poisoned Javelin
description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 6 (1d12) poison damage and the target is poisoned until the start of the creature’s next turn. A successful DC 11 Constitution save halves the poison damage and prevents poisoning.
